title: Manufacturing
description: Atlas Precision Components, a fictional maker of machined aluminum and steel parts with plants in Dayton, Monterrey and Brno: 56 CNC machines, presses, robot cells and grinders, 15 months of daily sensor readings, maintenance events, work orders and quality defects, beside maintenance and safety procedures, an 8D report, a supplier agreement, a plant review deck and a scanned handwritten round sheet.
disclaimer: Synthetic data for a software demonstration; Atlas Precision Components and every plant, machine, supplier, customer and person in it are fictional.

questions.label: PM-2 interval for hydraulic presses
questions.description: A value read from the maintenance interval table in the manual's PDF.
questions.question: What PM-2 interval does the preventive maintenance manual set for a hydraulic press, and how often is its hydraulic oil sampled?

questions.label: Findings on the handwritten round sheet
questions.description: Needs the scanned, handwritten PM-1 round sheet, which Nemotron Parse reads.
questions.question: On the scanned PM-1 round sheet for press DAY-PRS-03 dated 14 September 2026, what oil temperature did the operator record, and what action was raised for the ram seal?

questions.label: Removing someone else's lock
questions.description: The exceptional lock-removal rule in the lockout/tagout SOP.
questions.question: Under the lockout/tagout procedure, who may remove a lock applied by an authorized employee who is not on site, and what must happen before they do?

questions.label: Unplanned downtime by plant, Q3 2026
questions.description: A join of maintenance events, machines and plants, grouped by plant.
questions.question: Which plant had the most unplanned downtime hours in Q3 2026 (1 July to 30 September), and how many hours and unplanned events was that?

questions.label: Top failure codes by downtime
questions.description: Failure codes ranked by unplanned downtime hours over twelve months.
questions.question: Which three failure codes caused the most unplanned downtime hours between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026, and how many hours did each cause?

questions.label: Production plan attainment, Q3 2026
questions.description: Reads the weekly output sheet of the production plan workbook.
questions.question: Over the 12 weeks starting 6 July through 21 September 2026, which plant had the lowest production plan attainment (total actual units divided by total target units), and what was it?

questions.label: Machines overdue for PM-2
questions.description: Combines the interval table in the maintenance manual with each machine's last PM-2 in the tables.
questions.question: Using the PM-2 intervals in the preventive maintenance manual, which machines are overdue for their PM-2 service as of 30 September 2026, and by how many days?

questions.label: The 8D machine's recent history
questions.description: Finds the machine in the 8D report, then looks up its maintenance and quality history.
questions.question: The 8D report describes a bore-diameter escape on valve body AP-3312. Which machine does it name, and how many unplanned maintenance events, hours of unplanned downtime and dollars of quality defect cost has that machine logged since 1 July 2026?

questions.label: Machines most likely to fail next month
questions.description: A Kumo prediction of unplanned failure per machine over the next 30 days.
questions.question: Which machines are most likely to have an unplanned failure in the next 30 days? Give the five with the highest probability.

questions.label: Machines likely to raise many alarms
questions.description: A Kumo prediction of a high alarm count, joined to the machine details.
questions.question: Which five machines are most likely to log more than 10 alarms over the next 30 days, and what plant and machine type is each?
